mentions.name: Caravella
mentions.description: Open source Android app for splitting group expenses on trips, in shared flats and at events. Works with no account, no ads and no tracking, keeping all data on the phone. Groups are shared between phones over Wi-Fi or Bluetooth by pairing via QR code, with end-to-end encryption and no server involved. Expenses can be added by voice or by reading a receipt with the camera. Version 2.4 adds a simpler way to invite people into a group and settling up with the fewest payments.
mentions.source_excerpt: Caravella, an open source Android app to split group expenses for trips, shared flats and events. No account, no ads, no tracking: everything stays on your phone.
